**0.1.0: first public test build.**

Experimental, public testing. Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+.

Meorav (beta) speaks the text you type in Daniel Rosehill's voice (Irish-accented English with
Hebrew words), generated entirely on the phone with Qwen3-TTS (qwentts.cpp, CPU).

- First use downloads the voice model from cdn.hebrish.app: Q4_K_M, 1.44 GB (default), or
  Q8_0, 2.33 GB (needs 12 GB+ RAM). Resumable, SHA-256 checked, deletable in the app.
- Expect generation to be slower than real time, and about 4 GB of RAM in use while speaking.
- Play, save or share the result as a WAV; the app shows generation time and real-time factor.
- Non-commercial use only, under the Hebrish terms: https://hebrish.app/terms

Install from the Hebrish F-Droid repo (https://fdroid.hebrish.app/repo) or download the APK below.
